ignorePatterns.comment: Every SidCorp-co repo is private, and the checker runs unauthenticated — so a link to one answers 404 whether or not it exists. Scoped to the org rather than to `forge` because a cross-repo reference (e.g. an archmap issue cited from a Forge doc) hits exactly the same wall. What this mutes is a typo inside a SidCorp-co URL; what it would otherwise block is every correct one.

GitHub's advisory pages answer an unauthenticated CI request with no response at all — `Status: 0`, not 404 — so every CHANGELOG entry citing the GHSA it closed reads as a dead link. A GHSA id is an immutable identifier; the risk this mutes is a typo in one, which the advisory text beside it already makes visible.

replacementPatterns.comment: In-app help articles (packages/web-v2/content/help) link each other by bare route slug, e.g. [Pair a runner](pair-a-runner) — correct for the renderer, which routes by slug, but not a filesystem path. Append .md so the checker still VERIFIES the target exists instead of muting it: a genuinely dead slug keeps failing.
